thread:
maria: FYI, customer #C-19284 sees SSE stream silently close ~30s after switching from LTE -> WiFi. They get a partial JSON chunk (last object truncated) but billing shows full response tokens. Repro steps attached, trying to triage whether client or infra. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/C-19284 :frowning:

alex: can you paste the client headers and connection id? also what SDK/version?

maria: client is mobile web, sdk-js v1.6.2, connection id 2c7f8a9d, auth via bearer token. quick snippet from client console: 
```
EventSource url: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-lite&conn=2c7f8a9d
lastEventId: none
onmessage: partial chunk: '{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello, this is a test"},"index":0,'
close event fired after TCP close without error
```

kevin: might be NAT rebinding or proxy doing half-close on session change. any proxy in path? carrier -> home AP uses carrier NAT, then home router does CGNAT too. can you get tcpdump pcap from user's device or from our edge?

maria: user attached client logs and a remote tcpdump from their home router (pcap attached to ticket). quick grep shows TCP FIN coming from their IP right after the WiFi attach: 
```
14:03:12.123 IP 10.43.0.5.40123 > edge1.redwood.ai.443: Flags [P.], seq 1234:2345, ack 4321, win 64240
14:03:12.130 IP edge1.redwood.ai.443 > 10.43.0.5.40123: Flags [R], seq 4321, ack 2345, win 0
```

alex: RST from edge? that looks like our side closed. can we check edge logs around that conn id? tagging @sre-bot to pull the edge request trace and LB backend mapping.

sre-bot: pulled trace for conn=2c7f8a9d at 2026-03-17T14:03:12Z. Route: edge1 -> lb-03 -> runtime-a. No explicit 5xx. Backend returned stream chunk, then connection reset after 17ms. Flagging potential half-close due to client keepalive window exceeded.

kevin: interesting — could be our idle timeout mismatch when client IP changes mid-connection. We have SNI-based session mapping and a 30s keepalive probe. if client IP changes mid-flight, some LBs might send reset when they see a different flow.

maria: repro steps from user: 1) start streaming in mobile web over LTE; 2) walk into building, phone auto-joins home WiFi; 3) stream continues for ~20-40s then closes with truncated json. they repro reliably.

alex: can you ask the user to test with keepalive enabled (ping) or switching to websocket fallback? also capture client-side network change event. quick server-side mitigation: we can try bumping idle timeout to 90s for the customer route or enable 'graceful-fallback' to websocket on connection failure.

maria: pinged customer to try the keepalive hack (send a no-op event every 10s). they replied: "keeps working sometimes, but still truncates occasionally." they sent the full pcap and I see multiple flows with different 4-tuple after the WiFi attach.

kevin: next steps: 1) infra to experiment increasing LB idle timeout for customer route and enable connection reuse across IP changes (if possible); 2) eng-runtime to add server-side buffering/finish-chunk-on-reset so truncation is not charged as full token output and we can reconstruct last complete object; 3) support to advise customer to use websocket or client keepalive as workaround.

alex: noted. I'll open infra ticket to try a controlled change for this customer and collect metrics. kevin, can you triage whether runtime can atomically emit last complete JSON object on abrupt TCP close?

kevin: will look. initial thought: buffer last 512 bytes and close only after flushing last full object, then emit close event with truncated flag in header. planning spike.

maria: thanks. keeping ticket owner updated. marking urgent for billing review so we don't invoice truncated streams as full. :money_with_wings:
